mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates lower borrowing costs and economic stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market characterized by unemployment rates below 3.0% signals robust consumer spending power and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as investors price in sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST > 1350 and RSAFS > 690000) indicates broad-based consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as the market discounts sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1350 and RSAFS > 690000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-supply shock recovery regime, rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals improving manufacturing output and economic resilience, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100 during post-supply shock recovery, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1400 thousand units indicate strong residential construction activity, signaling robust consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as the market reacts to immediate demand signals.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as the market prices in higher borrowing costs and potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as the market anticipates stronger corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 150000) indicates a tight labor market with rising wages, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as the market prices in sustained consumer spending and corporate profit growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 150000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
